notes: 1) .wmModal is not a flag gate. ModalShell.js:474 always builds .wmModal, and #tableListingsBox is a token root at both flags (_wocg-tokens.scss:24). So the table preview dialog, the Stats dialog and the Find-tables box draw their icons (bot/liked/completion badges, the games-bar caret, the Stats chevron, the ticks) on the redesign palette with the flag off too. 2) The Daily challenge month panel, the frontpage and LobbyWidgets tiles only exist with the flag (LobbyWidgets.js:79), so the medals, dealDayCheck and the GameSelectors.scss badge chain are flag-on in practice. 3) Master shipped PNG versions of many of these icons (closeModal.png, dealer.png, dealerSmall.png, crown.png, botBadge.png, likedBadge.png, cleanMeldBadge.png, highReputationBadge.png, onlineBadge.png, playerLiked/More/Leaving.png, sortArrowLeft/Right.png, shootTheMoon/Sun.png, playMenu*.png, menuBurger.png, menuClose.png, arrowDown*.png; git diff --name-status master). This branch deleted them, so flag-off draws the SVG ports, not master's PNGs. 4) Outside static/images, the flag-off footer uses /facebook-48.png and /youtube-48.png from the web root (common/footer.dust:51-52), and the chat bubble tails come from pieces/chatBubble/classic/frame* (svg with the flag, png without, static/themes/classic/classic.js:58). static/themes/classic/classic.js and classic.css name no icon from the list. 5) Surprises: (a) the legacy yellow 'play this day' arrowDown leaks into the Daily challenge dialog on hover, over the day number and over the green check on a won day (specificity 0,3,1 beats the 0,2,1 reset; confirmed in Chromium); (b) the *NotificationHoverTransition.json Lotties are never loaded because User.js asks for *NotificationTransitionHover.json (404); (c) closeModal.svg and menuQuestion.png are white glyphs that need a dark ground, and the classic close crosses are still drawn on the legacy black scrim at both flags (Find-tables box, Help/Rules box); (d) the Friends panel's conversation header keeps master's #f8f9fa under the redesign, so the masked back arrow (sortArrowLeft) sits on the old grey, not the paper; (e) with the flag on, the seat side-row icons (crown, liked, more, leaving, sort arrows) moved from master's #f8f9fa chip disc onto the #f4eee5 band-paper tab, and the chat/hint/play/table icons moved from the #f8f9fa bottom bar onto the band-paper pills and seat buttons, all standing on the felt; (f) the dealer chip, cribbage board and pegs, hint arrows and suit particles keep their own art at both flags; (g) the completion badge draws 16px in the Find-tables box but 20px on the frontpage and in the preview dialog, although TableListingsBar.scss:135-140 says the two should match; (h) master's 88% #f8f9fa Game over / Hand over panel is now an opaque #f9f6f2 at flag-off too (the --go-paper fallback), so the header Lotties sit on the new paper in both states; (i) dead or hidden files: menuBurger.svg, ranksMenu*.png (preload only), experiencedBadge.png, onlineBadge.svg (dead CSS), menuQuestion.png, menuClose.svg (display:none), tableRules.svg and tableLeaderboard.svg (their pills are always disabled while the bar shows).
